title: Analog Drums
description: An exercise in synthesizing common drum sounds using analog methods, all built in Phaseplant with oscillators, basic filtering, and envelope manipulation. The techniques mirror what you'd find in hardware like an 808, minus the non-ideal circuit characteristics that we've all come to love.

audio.label: Latin Groove
audio.desc: A drum groove built around aux percussion. Toms, congas, rim hits, shakers, that sort of thing.

audio.label: Drum Kit
audio.desc: A standard groove using traditional kit instruments. Kick, snare, hi-hats, the usual.

audio.label: Mixed Groove
audio.desc: A groove pulling from both sets of instruments above.
